main_body: wooden barrel with an elliptical top lid and two horizontal grey metal hoops on the front cylindrical body
top_band: warm light-to-medium brown elliptical lid surface with a central tan highlight across rows 2-5, bounded by a darker brown front rim at row 6
evidence: Reading down the center column: row 1 is the back dark-brown rim, rows 2-5 form a 4px tall foreshortened elliptical top cap in lighter warm browns with a brighter tan center highlight at row 4, row 6 is a darker brown front lip/edge of the cap, and rows 7-14 form the curved vertical front face with two grey metal hoops (rows 7 and 11) and shaded vertical wooden staves.

style.evidence: The barrel uses 6 distinct warm brown/tan steps for the wood plus a 3-step grey ramp for the metal hoops, dark brown material-tinted outlines, clear stave grain and radial lid shading, with no flat fills.
